  "query_sql": "SELECT cc.dsc_nome_credor, c.vlr_contrato FROM contrato_contratos c LEFT JOIN contrato_contContrato cc ON c.seq_contrato = cc.seq_contrato AND c.ano_referencia = cc.ano_referencia JOIN orgao_orgao o ON c.cod_orgao = o.cod_orgao WHERE c.ano_referencia = 2025 AND CAST(c.cod_orgao AS INTEGER) IN (2, 4, 5) AND COALESCE(o.nom_orgao, '') ILIKE '%SAAE%' AND c.vlr_contrato > 0 ORDER BY c.vlr_contrato DESC LIMIT 10;",
